title: Remove PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET and the JWT authorizer; CLI authenticates with IAM (SigV4)
description: Ryan decision 2026-10-06: no long-lived token anywhere in the Papyrus design. Delete PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET, the custom JWT Lambda authorizer and refresh-jwt. The CLI and automation sign AppSync requests with SigV4 from the standard AWS credential chain (SSO, OIDC role, build role), authorized through a dedicated papyrus-authoring role created by infra/amplify-app-shell.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/133 (commit b99e113, branch feature/PPY-9febe4-iam-cli-auth). IAM (SigV4) CLI auth via the standard AWS credential chain; AppSync IAM authorization (enableIamAuthorizationMode) scoped by the new <siteId>-papyrus-authoring role (appsync:GraphQL on Query/Mutation fields, media/preview S3, Amplify jobs). JWT authorizer, PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET, refresh-jwt and all allow.custom rules removed. CI green (python, smoke, ts, unit). Expected release 1.0.0-next.11. Not merged.

right_now_summary: PR #133 adds SigV4 IAM authentication and removes JWT-based access.
